name: Stormbringer: Thorim's Gift leaves a damaging patch under the Arm of Thorim target (#2056)
contract: #2056: Thorim's Gift (570173) is a passive whose single effect is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 354, EffectBasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = 15 (the $s1 of its own description) and EffectTriggerSpell 570174. Aura 354 is nullptr in AuraEffectHandler (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:419) and has no case in AuraEffect::HandleProc, and 570173's own Spell.dbc ProcFlags are 4 (PROC_FLAG_DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK), which Arm of Thorim never raises, so nothing ever cast 570174. 570174 is SPELL_EFFECT_PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA with SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, EffectAmplitude 1000 ms, DurationIndex 27 (3000 ms) and EffectRadiusIndex 193 (6 yd), so it ticks 3000/1000 = 3 times, and its EffectBasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0 means the per-tick amount must be supplied by the caller. 570173's description reads 'dealing damage equal to $s1% of its damage dealt to enemies within every $570174t1 sec for $570174d', i.e. 15% per tick, the same per-tick convention Shock (804020) states explicitly as '($560336d*1000/$560336T1)*($707058m1)% of the initial damage'. The expected total is therefore 3 x 15% = 45% of the Arm of Thorim hit recorded in this same run; the asserted band allows the per-tick integer truncation (up to 3 damage out of a ~140 hit) and a small partial Nature resist on the ticks. 570174's own description ('20% ... over $570173d', where 570173's DurationIndex 21 is -1) contradicts its flavour text and its parent's data and is treated as stale.

steps.label: SETUP: Arm of Thorim needs its CasterAuraSpell 803102 (Static)
SETUP: the control Arm of Thorim cast lands
CONTROL: without Thorim's Gift no patch aura reaches the target
CONTROL: without Thorim's Gift the patch deals no damage
DIAGNOSTIC: Thorim's Gift is applied as a passive aura after learn
DISCRIMINATING: Thorim's Gift creates the 570174 ground effect under the target
DISCRIMINATING: the patch applies its periodic aura to the enemy in its 6 yd radius
SETUP: the measured Arm of Thorim cast lands
DISCRIMINATING: the patch ticks 3000 ms / 1000 ms = 3 times
DISCRIMINATING: the three ticks total 3 x 15% = 45% of this run's own Arm of Thorim hit
